experiments.title: Outcome-state verification
experiments.evidence: 400 cases independently verified. False-success acceptance: judge 7/200 (3.5%) versus state verifier 0/200; 205/400 judge responses violated the frozen schema. Required gap and collateral gates failed.
experiments.next: Completed: report and independent audit available. Schema noncompliance, observation access and template dependence limit the judge comparison.

experiments.title: Cascade containment
experiments.evidence: 480 workflows independently verified. Invalid-action escapes: 10/60 ungated versus 0/60 full containment. Clean success 51/60 (85%) missed the frozen 90% floor.
experiments.next: Completed: five-chapter report and independently verified evidence available. Replication and redesign require a new protocol.

experiments.title: Adaptive investigation stopping
experiments.evidence: 400 cases / 3,200 rounds verified. Reviewed stopping accuracy 34.5% versus fixed-long 54.25%; incorrect early endpoints later corrected in 34/400 cases (8.5%); all cases required review.
experiments.next: Completed: report, frozen cloud verification and separate local numerical replay available. Any policy redesign needs a new protocol.
